<xform:select property="extendDataFormInfo.value(fd_choice)" required="true" showPleaseSelect="true" onValueChange="__xformDispatch"><xform:simpleDataSource value="READY">Ready</xform:simpleDataSource><xform:simpleDataSource value="OTHER">Other</xform:simpleDataSource></xform:select>
<script>AttachXFormValueChangeEventById("fd_choice", function(value, domElement) {
unknownCall();var marker=GetXFormFieldById("fd_marker")[0];
if(value.indexOf("READY")>=0){marker.value="active";common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("fd_details_row",true,true,false);}
else{marker.value="inactive";common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("fd_details_row",false,false,false);}
});</script>
